title: JobRun
description: One attempt of a scheduled job. Host-agnostic. Timestamps are honest ISO-8601 UTC instants. Terminal states are ok, failed, and dead-lettered. running is the open attempt those states close.

job_id.description: Stable id of the job this attempt belongs to. The pattern is the library rule: no slash or backslash, no `..`, no ASCII control characters, no U+2028 or U+2029, and no leading or trailing whitespace. The forbidden-token checks scan every character. A space in the middle is allowed. Length is 1 to 200.

timeout_ms.description: Attempt budget in milliseconds. A running attempt past this budget is stale.

state.description: running is open. ok, failed, and dead-lettered are terminal for this attempt.

finished_at.description: Null while running. Set when the attempt reaches a terminal state.

next_attempt_at.description: When the next attempt may start. Set only on a failed attempt that still has a retry. Null on ok, dead-lettered, running, and a failed attempt with no retry scheduled. A model call with a null cost_cap cannot set this field. The library also requires null once attempt equals retry.max_attempts, and, when the value is set, requires it to equal finished_at plus the backoff delay for this attempt. The schema cannot compare those two integers or compute the delay.

makes_model_call.description: True when this job calls a model. A retry then requires an explicit cost_cap.

cost_cap.description: Explicit caller-defined ceiling. Null means no cap was declared. A finite number greater than or equal to zero is an explicit cap. When makes_model_call is true and attempt is at least 2, cost_cap must be that number. A failed model call with a null cost_cap cannot set next_attempt_at. This field does not authorize spend.

error.description: Null on running and ok. A non-empty string on failed and dead-lettered. The string branch rejects common absolute host paths: a POSIX / after the start or a non-path character, a home shortcut at a token boundary (`~`, then any run of non-whitespace non-separator characters, then / or \, including ~/), a Windows drive letter, and a UNC \\ share. It does not treat an https:// or http:// URL as a drive path, and a bare ~ in prose is not a home shortcut. The library check is authoritative and may reject additional private paths.

timestamp.description: Canonical ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision. The library also rejects impossible calendar dates.

max_attempts.description: Total attempts allowed, including the first. The attempt that reaches this count dead-letters on failure.

backoff.description: Delay before the next attempt, computed from the attempt that just failed.

multiplier.description: Delay after attempt n is floor(initial_ms * multiplier^(n-1)), then capped by max_ms when set. When multiplier is below 1 and initial_ms is already at least max_ms, the delay starts at the cap and then decays below it. The library computes that delay.

max_ms.description: Optional ceiling on the computed delay.

allOf.description: A dead-lettered record has no next attempt. The library also rejects it unless attempt equals retry.max_attempts. The schema cannot compare those two integers.
